Explanation:  
The Ground Truth Answer states that Harvard University was "140 years old" when Simon Fraser was born. The Predicted Answer calculates that Harvard was "139 years old—about 139 years and 7 months" at the time of Fraser's birth. The calculation in the Predicted Answer gives a very similar age (139 years and 7 months); this is effectively the same as saying "140 years old," since Harvard would formally turn 140 about five months after Fraser's birth. The difference is minor and likely comes down to rounding differences or conventions (i.e., whether to round up or down based on months). The essential fact—that Harvard was about 140 years old when Simon Fraser was born—is present in the Predicted Answer.

Decision: TRUE
